Comparable rail operator (verified by web search, 2026-11-24, search-result summaries of media reprints of China Railway's 重点旅客 rules, e.g. news.ifeng.com, m.gmw.cn, paper.people.com.cn): the rule is phrased 办理时限原则上不晚于开车前60分钟, 提前到达约定的旅客会合点, 车站工作人员, 协助乘降. Our 发车前至少 1 小时 / 到达车站 / 工作人员 / 协助 fall within that register. 开车前 not adopted: the approved page already uses 发车 (bus table head) and termbase/batch wording is binding.
重点旅客服务 rejected for the label: it is China Railway's own programme name and would attribute a Chinese institutional category to SAR.
